rule: Do not allow one jurisdiction status to overwrite another. FDACS ACTIVE and Palm Beach LICENSED are distinct facts.

conflict_types.JURISDICTIONAL_DIFFERENCE: Both facts can be correct (different regulators / jurisdictions). Preserve both with provenance.
conflict_types.TEMPORAL_DIFFERENCE: Retrieval or effective dates differ; both observations may be historically correct.
conflict_types.IDENTITY_REVIEW: Potentially different businesses. Plausible overlap without deterministic same-entity proof.
conflict_types.TRUE_DATA_CONFLICT: Same fact / same jurisdiction / same time window genuinely conflicts. Preserve both source values; do not silently overwrite.
conflict_types.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Evidence supports incompatible business identities under deterministic rules.
conflict_types.CROSS_SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Needs human review before any canonical attachment.

provenance_rule: Every retained observation must keep source agency, source URL/record id, and retrieval timestamp. Never collapse multi-jurisdiction facts into one field.
